question: In triangle ABC, AB = AC and ∠A = 80º, then find ∠B.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since AB = AC, the triangle is isosceles and angles opposite to equal sides are equal (∠B = ∠C).

∠B = (180º − ∠A) ÷ 2

∠B = (180º − 80º) ÷ 2 = 100º ÷ 2 = 50º

**∴ The correct answer is 50º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, AB = AC

∠A = 80º

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all internal angles of a triangle is 180º.

Angles opposite to equal sides of an isosceles triangle are equal.

**Calculation:**

⇒ In ΔABC, AB = AC

⇒ Therefore, ∠B = ∠C

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180º

⇒ 80º + ∠B + ∠B = 180º

⇒ 2 × ∠B = 180º − 80º

⇒ 2 × ∠B = 100º

⇒ ∠B = 100º ÷ 2

⇒ ∠B = 50º

**∴ The correct answer is 50º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Isosceles Triangle Properties

A triangle with two equal sides is an isosceles triangle. The angles opposite to the equal sides are always equal.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always equal to 180º.

Exterior Angle Theorem

The exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles: ∠Ext = ∠Int₁ + ∠Int₂.
